Subject: Post-call recap + requested next steps (technical deep-dive)

Hi Sarah, Andrei, Aisha — great to meet on the call earlier. Quick recap and two asks so we can get the tech deep-dive scheduled: 

Summary of what we covered:
- Current integration: replicating embeddings at query time, ~30ms p99 latency target for the US workload
- Data residency: EU patient samples need to stay within EU 
- Success criteria for pilot: <100ms end-to-end latency for representative queries and clear cost estimates for 50k requests/day

Asks / next steps:
1) Can we lock a 90-minute technical deep-dive where our Solutions Engineer (Vanessa) does architecture + deploy plan and your infra lead can bring a sample dataset?
2) Because the team spans US/EU/APAC, would you prefer a single rotating weekly time (we propose a three-week rotation) or a static time that favors one region? 
3) Please share two 90-minute windows that work for each attendee this coming week — we'll propose a rotation that makes sure each region gets a friendly hour at least once every three weeks.

Proposed guardrails from our side (we can be flexible):
- Week A: US-friendly (17:00 UTC / 10:00 PDT)
- Week B: EU-friendly (08:00 UTC / 09:00 CET)
- Week C: APAC-friendly (03:00 UTC / 13:30 IST)

If you share times, Vanessa will put together a compact rotation matrix and send a calendar invite with options. Attached is a quick blank grid we use for multi-zone coordination.

Thanks — I’ll leave the scheduling to Vanessa once you share availability.

Karthik Iyer

karthik@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198
